draws_instants_check.name: draws_instants_check
draws_instants_check.value: "draws"."stop_at" >= "draws"."committed_at" AND ("draws"."spin_start_at" IS NULL OR ("draws"."spin_start_at" >= "draws"."committed_at" AND "draws"."stop_at" >= "draws"."spin_start_at")) AND ("draws"."veto_ends_at" IS NULL OR "draws"."veto_ends_at" >= "draws"."stop_at")

draws_spin_check.name: draws_spin_check
draws_spin_check.value: CASE WHEN "draws"."kind" = 'spin' THEN "draws"."spin_start_at" IS NOT NULL AND "draws"."slice_game_ids" IS NOT NULL AND "draws"."result_index" IS NOT NULL AND "draws"."result_offset" IS NOT NULL ELSE "draws"."spin_start_at" IS NULL AND "draws"."slice_game_ids" IS NULL AND "draws"."slice_labels" IS NULL AND "draws"."result_index" IS NULL AND "draws"."result_offset" IS NULL END

draws_result_check.name: draws_result_check
draws_result_check.value: "draws"."kind" <> 'spin' OR ("draws"."result_index" >= 0 AND "draws"."result_index" < cardinality("draws"."slice_game_ids") AND "draws"."slice_game_ids"["draws"."result_index" + 1] = "draws"."game_id" AND ("draws"."slice_labels" IS NULL OR cardinality("draws"."slice_labels") = cardinality("draws"."slice_game_ids")) AND "draws"."result_offset" >= 0 AND "draws"."result_offset" < 1)

event_members_team_word_team_check.name: event_members_team_word_team_check
event_members_team_word_team_check.value: "event_members"."team_word" IS NULL OR "event_members"."team" IS NOT NULL

rounds_put_back_after_set_check.name: rounds_put_back_after_set_check
rounds_put_back_after_set_check.value: "rounds"."put_back_at" IS NULL OR "rounds"."set_at" IS NOT NULL

sessions_one_running_per_event_idx.name: sessions_one_running_per_event_idx
sessions_one_running_per_event_idx.where: "sessions"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "sessions"."removed_at" IS NULL

sessions_ended_after_started_check.name: sessions_ended_after_started_check
sessions_ended_after_started_check.value: "sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "sessions"."started_at" IS NOT NULL
